name: whatsapp-mcp
headline: Nekro-Agent: Extensible Multi-User Chatbot Framework
short_description: Nekro-agent is a versatile, extensible multi-user chatbot framework that integrates code execution capabilities and supports various platforms like QQ, Discord, and Minecraft. Its sandbox-driven and multimodal features make it ideal for interactive applications.
author: KroMiose

sections.overview:
Nekro-agent is an extensible chatbot framework designed for building interactive applications across multiple platforms including QQ, Discord, and Minecraft. The framework provides sandbox-driven code execution capabilities, enabling agents to safely run code while supporting multi-user interactions. It features multimodal support and is built for developers who need a flexible, platform-agnostic foundation for deploying AI agents. The architecture supports both simple and complex chatbot scenarios through its modular, extensible design. Nekro-agent is particularly suited for teams building cross-platform chat applications that require code execution and real-time user engagement.
Automate customer support interactions on Discord, providing instant responses to user queries.
Facilitate real-time collaboration among players in Minecraft, enhancing gameplay experiences.
Generate automated responses in QQ to streamline communication and improve user engagement.
Enhance live streaming sessions on Bilibili Live by integrating interactive features for viewers.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install KroMiose/nekro-agent`
`git clone https://github.com/KroMiose/nekro-agent`
sections.usage:
```
Set up a Nekro-agent chatbot for [PLATFORM] to handle [SPECIFIC TASK]. The bot should integrate with [API/TOOL] and execute [CODE FUNCTIONALITY]. Ensure it supports [NUMBER] concurrent users and includes [FEATURES] for enhanced interaction.
```
Copy

```
The Nekro-agent chatbot for Discord has been successfully configured to manage customer support queries. It integrates with the Zendesk API to fetch and update ticket statuses. The bot can execute Python scripts to analyze customer sentiment from support tickets and generate summary reports. It supports up to 100 concurrent users and includes voice command recognition and multilingual support for enhanced interaction. The bot is now live and ready to handle customer inquiries 24/7.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
